missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Даль' is the feminine nominative subject of 'манит'. 'Синяя' is the agreeing feminine adjective. A poetic but natural way to describe the horizon.

Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Даль' is the accusative object after 'в', showing where the gaze is directed. 'Туманную' agrees in the feminine accusative. A common gazing-into-the-distance pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В дали' uses the prepositional form 'дали' after 'в' to express where the ship vanished. 'Морской' agrees in the feminine prepositional. Note the third-declension ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Из дали' uses the genitive form 'дали' after 'из' to show where the sound comes from. 'Тихая песня' is the nominative subject. A natural sensory description.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Далью' is the instrumental case governed by 'любовались', which takes the instrumental. 'Голубой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A classic admiring construction.

Strategic focus: Nominative with instrumental predicate. 'Даль' is nominative as the subject of 'кажется', which takes an instrumental predicate. 'Бесконечной' and 'тихой' describe the distance. A reflective description.
Strategic focus: Dative plural with preposition. 'Далям' is the dative plural after 'навстречу', which governs the dative. The plural evokes wide open spaces. A useful motion-toward pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О далях' uses the prepositional plural form after 'о' to express what people dream about. 'Туристы' is the nominative plural subject. Good for plural practice.
Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Дали' is the genitive form used after the negated verb 'не вижу'. 'Никакой' agrees in the feminine genitive. A standard negation pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Даль' is the nominative subject of the short adjective 'видна'. 'Светлая' agrees in the feminine, and 'за горами' is the instrumental location. A scenic description.
